gen-audiowide-gf-tiny5: Tile-like and futuristic, Audiowide traces a constant-width outline you could follow with a fingertip, while Tiny5 stands tall with stubby-looking ascenders. A longer passage in it would read clean and approachable.
gen-audiowide-gf-viga: Audiowide goes full futuristic, with strokes that never thicken or thin. Viga sits beside it with hairline-free, shadow-free strokes and barely taller capitals, so the techy heading and the body feel like one machine in two gears.
gen-audiowide-gf-voces: Futuristic, Audiowide draws every line as if with a ruler and compass. Voces adds a tall lowercase with a slight swell on its bowls, leaving the heading to do its best work big and brief.
gen-audiowide-gf-winky-rough: Winky Rough reads contemporary and businesslike, with a body height that nearly matches its capitals. And Audiowide, whose crossbars match its stems, looks best given generous size up top.
gen-audiowide-gf-yantramanav: Curves as uniform as a drawn thread give Audiowide its futuristic, tile-like look, while Yantramanav tucks its lowercase close together. Across many lines, the body stays modern and clean.
gen-comfortaa-gf-cambay: Neon-tube roundness: Comfortaa draws its c as an open ring, while Cambay's rounds gap like a cracked bangle. Heading and body make a friendly, contemporary team on the page.
gen-comfortaa-gf-cantarell: Friendly and geometric, Comfortaa draws every stroke like neon tubing, with spacing stretched out like an uncoiled spring. Cantarell grounds it with approachable text whose curves pull their tips apart.
gen-comfortaa-gf-catamaran: Catamaran is the body here, approachable and neutral, with curvy letters that feel unclamped. But Comfortaa is the showier of the two, its curves never thinning at the shoulders.
gen-comfortaa-gf-chiron-hei-hk: Friendly, wire-like tubes make up Comfortaa, while Chiron Hei HK stretches its c like a bracelet pulled apart. Whole paragraphs set in it would read as modern and professional.
gen-comfortaa-gf-doto: Doto leaves wide margins of space around each glyph, with generous mouths on its round letters. Doto sits under Comfortaa's wire-cut strokes, and the modern, approachable pair feels like one friendly system.
